title: JEE Main 2026 (April 2nd, Shift 2) - Chemistry - Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: The ratio of mass percentage (w/w) of C : H in a hydrocarbon is $12 : 1$. It has two carbon atoms. The weight (in g) of $\text{CO}_2(g)$ formed when $3.38\text{ g}$ of this hydrocarbon is completely burnt in oxygen is : (Given : Molar mass in $\text{g mol}^{-1}$ C : 12, H : 1, O : 16)
questions.explain:
Ratio of mass of C to H is $12 : 1$. Moles of C = $12 / 12 = 1$. Moles of H = $1 / 1 = 1$. Thus, the empirical formula is $\text{CH}$.
Since it has two carbon atoms, the molecular formula is $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2$ (Ethyne).
Molar mass of $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2 = 24 + 2 = 26\text{ g/mol}$.
Moles of $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2$ burned = $3.38 / 26 = 0.13\text{ mol}$.
Combustion reaction: $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2 + \frac{5}{2} \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{CO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$.
1 mol of $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2$ produces 2 mol of $\text{CO}_2$.
So, $0.13\text{ mol}$ of $\text{C}_2\text{H}_2$ will produce $2 \times 0.13 = 0.26\text{ mol}$ of $\text{CO}_2$.
Mass of $\text{CO}_2 = 0.26 \times 44 = 11.44\text{ g}$.

questions.q:
Complete combustion of $X\text{ g}$ of an organic compound gave $0.25\text{ g}$ of $\text{CO}_2$ and $0.12\text{ g}$ of $\text{H}_2\text{O}$. If the % of carbon is $25\%$ and of hydrogen is $4.89\%$, then X = {_____}$ \times 10^{-3}\text{ g}$. (Nearest integer)
(Molar mass of C, H and O are $12, 1$ and $16\text{ g mol}^{-1}$ respectively.)
questions.explain:
Percentage of carbon is given by: $\% C = \frac{12}{44} \times \frac{\text{Mass of } CO_2}{X} \times 100$.
Substitute the given values:
$25 = \frac{12}{44} \times \frac{0.25}{X} \times 100 \implies 25 = \frac{3}{11} \times \frac{25}{X} \implies X = \frac{3}{11} = 0.2727\text{ g}$.
Checking the hydrogen formula gives a comparable answer:
$\% H = \frac{2}{18} \times \frac{0.12}{X} \times 100 = 4.89 \implies X = \frac{2}{18} \times \frac{12}{4.89} = \frac{1.333}{4.89} = 0.2726\text{ g}$.
Thus, $X = 0.273\text{ g}$, which corresponds to $273 \times 10^{-3}\text{ g}$. So the missing integer value is $273$.
